notes.text: Plates gate blocked: fg-right-crane and logo intentionally differ from comp per user (2026-10-04). --force refused 4x (validator does not parse the Korean quotes). Intro built and verified manually at 1672x941 and 390x844; comp-diff 66%. Remaining: hero record, motion/responsive gates, finish review, DESIGN.md.

2026-10-04: user approved the first viewport (component-review hero session fd28cceb..., visualDecision approved). Hero gate still refuses on 'clipped plate' vetoes for mid-yard, fg-right-crane and logo. These are artifacts of comparing layered cutouts to a flattened comp: the left crane covers the yard's left edge in the comp, the crane leg is cut by the frame edge, and the sky around the logo reads as ink. Numeric readings are advisory after acceptance.

reasons: region nav-right is missing (detail 7%, structure 59%): the comp shows material the build does not

plate logo is placed but not at the comp's box: its ink spans 162x24px at (13,8) in the comp region and 142x24px at (46,8) in the build; size and position the to the spec box (object-fit: cover), not to the surrounding layout

region nav-left (control) is contradicted (structure 50%, detail added 33%): this control differs from the comp: inspect its lettering and visible shape separately against the crop and the measured readings; preserve the region's control classification
